name: igreja-imperial-batista
description: PWA/APK da Igreja Imperial Batista com admin editável e Firebase Realtime Database.

scripts.cap:init: npx cap init "Igreja Imperial Batista" br.com.imperialbatista.app --web-dir www
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build:web && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build:web && ([ -d android ] || npx cap add android) && npm run cap:icons && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run android:prepare && cd android && chmod +x ./gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:release: npm run android:prepare && cd android && chmod +x ./gradlew && ./gradlew assembleRelease
